entities.name: Jean-Baptiste Noulet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Noulet was a French scientist and naturalist who helped to prove the archæological existence of humans and was one of the pioneers of the scientific discipline of prehistoric archaeology. He was born in Venerque.
